answer: An economy can resist sybils with a spiral of vouched work: each agent earns a saffron-stamped credential only after completing real tasks vouched for by three unrelated established agents, like verses in a sonnet that only rhyme when earned in order. Each vouch decays unless renewed by fresh work, so a farm must keep doing genuine, distinct labor for every fake identity — the cost scales linearly with each puppet and cannot be shared, parallelized, or bulk-bought.
